about.title: About
about.heroSubtitle: One house, two practices: private wealth custody for discerning clients, and structured capital for qualified enterprises.
about.whoText: Seated in Zurich, SBDV preserves private wealth with discretion and arranges mandate-aligned capital facilities for qualified enterprises — under documented review, Swiss AML standards, and clear repayment terms.
about.sectionDescription: A Swiss institution built for quiet custody and disciplined enterprise capital — not retail noise.
about.missionText: To preserve wealth and trust with Swiss precision — and to enable qualified enterprises to grow with structured, stress-free capital under the same standard of integrity.
about.visionText: To be the Swiss house clients choose when custody must stay silent and capital must stay disciplined — trusted by private wealth and by enterprises that prefer clarity over chaos.
about.aboutParagraph1: Swiss Bullion Depository Vault is a Zurich-seated institution. We combine private vault custody with a Capital Access Program for qualified operating companies — two practices, one Swiss standard of discretion and review.
about.aboutParagraph2: Private clients come for vault custody or a wealth mandate. Enterprises come for transparent facility structure, KYC/UBO look-through, and a partner portal that keeps the process legible from application to repayment.
about.aboutParagraph3: We do not compete on hype. We compete on documentation, mandate alignment, and the quiet confidence of Swiss operating discipline.

wealth.approachTitle: A quiet mandate, not a marketplace
wealth.approachDescription: This is a private-client investment mandate, not a bank account and not a crypto exchange. Bitcoin is only a way to fund. Yield is a stated mandate rate SBDV may change. Principal is not withdrawn in this programme — you fund, watch growth, and elect how to treat interest.
wealth.feesDescription: Mandate terms, including the stated yield and any fees, are disclosed in writing before you fund. No hidden transaction costs, retrocessions, or kickbacks.
wealth.disclaimer: This is not a bank deposit and is not covered by deposit-insurance schemes. Mandate yield is not guaranteed and may be paused or revised. Investments involve risk, including possible loss of principal. Bitcoin transfers are irreversible; SBDV does not custody your private keys or operate a crypto exchange. Information on this page is not investment, legal, or tax advice.

legal.privacyIntro: Swiss Bullion Depository Vault (SBDV) complies with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP) and international privacy standards.
legal.privacyBody: We collect personal information solely for the purpose of providing vault custody, investment, and membership services. Data is processed with strict confidentiality, stored securely, and never sold to third parties. Clients may request access, correction, or deletion of their personal data by contacting our data protection officer.
legal.termsIntro: These terms govern your use of SBDV services and client portal.
legal.termsBody: By engaging SBDV services, you agree to comply with Swiss KYC and AML requirements. Vault custody, investment advisory, and portfolio management services are provided subject to separate service agreements. SBDV reserves the right to modify services with appropriate notice to clients.
legal.regulatoryIntro: Important information regarding our regulatory status and client protections.
legal.regulatoryBody: SBDV operates under Swiss financial security and privacy frameworks. Investment and portfolio management services may require appropriate licensing or be provided through regulated partners. All clients undergo KYC and AML screening. Risk disclosures: investments involve risk including possible loss of principal. Past performance is not indicative of future results.
legal.investorRelationsBody: SBDV is committed to transparency with our clients and stakeholders. Annual reports, governance policies, and institutional disclosures will be published here as they become available. For institutional inquiries, please contact our investor relations team through the contact page.

whoCanApply.title: Who can apply
whoCanApply.worldwide: Enterprises worldwide may apply. Vault membership is by invitation; Capital Access is open to qualified companies.
whoCanApply.enterprise: This is not a personal or consumer loan. The applicant must be an operating company.
whoCanApply.ticket: Minimum request USD 500,000; two years of operating history; audited or reviewed financials.
whoCanApply.kyc: Full KYC, beneficial-ownership look-through, and sanctions screening under Swiss AML rules.
whoCanApply.sanctions: Comprehensively sanctioned persons and jurisdictions cannot be onboarded. Approval is always discretionary.
whoCanApply.currency: Facilities are denominated in USD. If your operating cash flow is in another currency, you accept foreign-exchange risk.

timeline.title: Indicative timeline
timeline.note: Times are typical, not a commitment. Incomplete files or enhanced due diligence take longer.
